name: Time-varying INR compression via Laplacian pyramid
aliases: Tang and Wang [141] Laplacian Pyramid INR
definition: Decomposes time-varying volumes via a Laplacian pyramid with per-block MLPs to improve decoding speed.
summary: Time-varying INR compression via Laplacian pyramid decomposes volumetric data into a multiscale pyramid with local neural models, achieving 13–30× faster decoding than centralized approaches.
